method: Curated primary Library of Congress catalogue records. Titles, publication years, creators and digital identifiers were checked against the original catalogue's indexed metadata. Image URLs follow the Library's documented IIIF API. Place anchors are explicitly approximate orientation points; no map boundaries or depicted dates are inferred. Live image endpoint verification must be run from a network that can reach loc.gov.
